title: Named uniquely normalized coherent comparison family
statement: For a compact separated scheme X, construct affineNormalizedComparisonFamily as the unique family provided by exists_unique_qcoherentNormalizedComparison [lem-weil-pbc-qcoherent-normalized-comparison-exists]. It assigns to each quasi-coherent X-module F and degree q an additive equivalence from ordinary module cohomology to lifted coherent etale cohomology. Prove that its composite with the inverse module/abelian cohomology comparison has the prescribed normalization. The witness is determined uniquely, so the construction names the existing chosen family rather than an arbitrary existence witness.

source.place: Tags 03P2 and 03FD; defining equation of the canonical normalized affine comparison.

proof.text: Define the family by Classical.choose of exists_unique_qcoherentNormalizedComparison. This existence theorem determines the entire family by equality. For normalization, unfold the named family and project the normalization field from Classical.choose_spec. Empty schemes, zero modules and degree zero are included. The named construction prevents repeated expansion of its complete existence predicate at fibre-product schemes.

lean.statement:
def affineNormalizedComparisonFamily (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [Scheme.IsSeparated X] :
    ∀ (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ),
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj F) ≃+
        Sheaf.H (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) q
